Reto Grammar (past tense)

Cómo hacerlo

Escoge 6 de las 9 oraciones de la escena y graba un video de máximo 2 minutos donde se vea tu cara y tu boca leyéndolas. Antes de grabar, practica con los audios: toca Normal y Lento, escucha y repite en voz alta hasta que te sientas cómodo.

Postea tu video en el feed de la comunidad con el hashtag #ChallengePastTense
¿No sabes cómo? Mira aquí el video donde te explico paso a paso ▶

💬 Al publicar tu video en la comunidad, vas a recibir feedback para seguir mejorando.

Qué grabar

  1. Escoge 6 oraciones de la lista.
  2. Lee cada una 1 vez, imitando el ritmo y la entonación de la escena.

Escucha la escena

  • ▶Escena completa

Las oraciones

  • OraciónEscuchar
  • 1When I was like 12, 13, I had a friend, his name was Diomi.
  • 2My friend Brian, him and I and Diomi were just great friends and we uh, we spent a lot of time together
  • 3and when I was 15 I obviously got signed, started making music
  • 4and, you know, went off and started touring and Diomi and I just kind of started to disconnect and
  • 5you know, when I was like 18, around 18, Brian called me one day and he said “hey man, Diomi, he passed away in his sleep last night”
  • 6yeah, he overdosed.
  • 7And I remember when I heard it Brian was on the phone crying and I was just kind of like somewhere on tour and
  • 8I just like felt numb, like, I didn’t really feel anything.
  • 9I just kind of went on with everything and time just went on.
